course.title: R Language — Beginner to Advanced
course.description: A complete, visual-first R curriculum spanning language fundamentals, data structures, wrangling, visualization, exploratory analysis, statistical inference, modeling, integrations, reproducible reporting, Shiny, engineering quality, packages, advanced internals, specialist domains and professional practice. All generated content remains draft until expert review.
course.version_scope: Core language examples follow the R release manuals currently published at CRAN. Ecosystem tools are linked to their official reference documentation; package APIs and deployment behavior must be checked against their installed versions immediately before publishing. Curriculum source reviewed 2026-10-17.
prerequisites: No previous programming experience is required. Basic computer skills and comfort with arithmetic help; statistical foundations are introduced before advanced analysis and modeling.
learning_outcomes: Write and debug R programs using functions, vectors, structured data, control flow and reusable abstractions.
Import, validate, clean, summarize and visualize data with base R and established ecosystem tools.
Apply statistical and modeling methods while checking assumptions, uncertainty, leakage and limitations.
Build reproducible reports and interactive Shiny applications with tests, project environments and documentation.
Develop maintainable analytical workflows and packages with safe integration, security and deployment practices.
